name: object_field3c_getter
description: Ordinary C++ accessor for the +0x3C dword compiled with a synthetic array caller so the native LTCG register allocator keeps the argument and the result in EAX as retail does.

functions.name: ManagedObject_GetField3C
functions.actual_abi: object in EAX; result in EAX; plain RET

context.description: Synthetic array-processing caller that establishes the observed register convention; not recovered game code.
